name: eMACS J1419.1-0624 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J1419.1-0624, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj141910624-hubble
story: A distant, massive cluster of galaxies, found because its hot gas shines so brightly in X-rays. Hubble visited it in a quick survey hunting the most massive clusters for powerful natural lenses.

claims.text: eMACSJ1419.1-0624 is a galaxy cluster in the eMACS sample of extremely X-ray luminous clusters
eMACS is an X-ray selected cluster survey
Hubble observed it in a snapshot survey of the most massive clusters, aiming to find powerful gravitational lenses
